chunks: And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
"What an excellent condiment vinegar is; a house in which there is vinegar does not become destitute."

key_terms.أَقْفَرَ: became destitute or emptied of provision
key_terms.الْإِدَامُ: condiment or food accompaniment eaten with bread
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نِعْمَ: an expression of praise meaning excellent or fine

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about vinegar?
ai.summary: This hadith praises vinegar as an excellent condiment and presents it as a sign of simple household sufficiency. It reflects an ethic of contentment and appreciation for modest provisions in daily life.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4267 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said:
"What an excellent condiment vinegar is! A house that has vinegar will never be destitute."
